segments.name: Infrastructure
segments.description: Manages infrastructure fund series and perpetual vehicles that invest in high-quality infrastructure assets for institutional and private wealth clients.
segments.evidence: Infrastructure: Primarily includes managing our flagship infrastructure fund series focused on investing in high-quality infrastructure assets on a value basis.

segments.name: Renewable Power and Transition
products: flagship renewable power and transition fund series
segments.description: Manages renewable power and transition funds and BEP, investing in clean energy and net-zero transition assets for clients.
segments.evidence: Renewable Power and Transition: Primarily includes managing our flagship renewable power and transition fund series focused on investments aimed at accelerating the global transition to a net-zero carbon economy and driving clean energy investments in emerging markets.

segments.name: Private Equity
segments.description: Manages opportunistic, thematic and regional private equity funds and BBU for institutional and private wealth investors.
segments.evidence: Private Equity: Includes managing our global opportunistic flagship funds, special investments strategy, secondaries strategy, thematic private equity strategies and regional private equity strategies.

segments.name: Real Estate
products: opportunistic real estate flagship fund series
segments.description: Manages opportunistic real estate funds, secondaries and perpetual core plus vehicles for institutional and private wealth clients.
segments.evidence: Real Estate: Includes the management of our opportunistic real estate flagship fund series and secondaries strategy.

segments.name: Credit
segments.description: Manages private, opportunistic, structured and liquid credit strategies that provide capital solutions to borrowers for clients.
segments.evidence: Credit: Includes managing our private credit strategies, opportunistic credit strategies, structured credit strategies, and liquid credit strategies.

revenueModel.text: Clients, including pensions, endowments, sovereign funds, insurers and private wealth investors, pay asset management income on the capital we invest for them.
revenueModel.evidence: We earn asset management income for doing so and ensure strong alignment of interests with our clients by investing Brookfield capital alongside them.
